messages:
jamie: hey @rita @lee — I addressed the comments on the depgraph PR and split the change into two commits like you suggested. added a small unit test and the error-handling tweak. CI was flaky previously so I re-ran the failing job. trying to get this into tonight's canary, PTAL when you have a minute
rita: thanks — will take a quick look this morning. any perf/regression concerns?
jamie: no perf regressions on my local runs (quick perf smoke). numbers stayed within noise. diff: https://git.example.com/redwood/infra/depgraph/+/PR-482
lee: skimmed — overall looks good. left one comment about the parse->validate flow (parse.go). if you can make that check null-safe that's ideal, otherwise reply to the comment with rationale
jamie: ack, fixed that in commit 2 and added a tiny test to cover the null path. also pinned the runtime flag we talked about to avoid the intermittent timeout: `--depgraph-timeout=5s`
ci-bot: build #482.2 rerun by jamie — ✅ all checks passed (unit: 78, integration: 112, flaky-suite skipped: 1) — commit abc123
rita: sweet. can you reserve a canary slot with ops? nights are best (22:00–23:00 PT) for minimal traffic
jamie: pinged @ops-bot to reserve 22:15 PT canary window and added a rollback patch. smoke command I used: `make smoke TEST=depgraph` — I'll run it again pre-canary and post results here
ops-bot: canary slot reserved for 2024-07-09 22:15 PT (window 30m). contact @oncall if you need to extend or abort
lee: :thumbsup: looked at both commits again — approve from me pending green canary
rita: I'll give final once we see canary metrics. also please drop a short changelog blurb (2–3 lines) for release notes
jamie: done — added CHANGELOG entry under "infra" and linked to the PR. I'll post canary results in this thread after the run. thanks y'all!
